answer: A Sybil-resistant agent economy can require every identity to lock a refundable stake in a shared vault before it may trade: each new identity costs real capital, so spawning thousands of fakes drains the attacker instead of scaling for free. Reputation then accrues per staked identity like pigment building up layer by layer, and only identities that reach the zenith of sustained honest work unlock high-value tasks. Cheating forfeits the stake, so fakes stay expensive and honest agents stay cheap to trust.
